jobs.title: Product Manager, Core Experience
jobs.description:
In just five years, Stora has become the platform behind more than 30% of UK self storage locations, and we're scaling globally from here. Operators have processed over £150m in automated payments through us, and see an average of 32% business growth after they switch.

We're doing this in a market that's wide open. Europe has over 10,000 self storage sites and is growing fast, yet it sits years behind the US on maturity and is still barely touched by good software. The UK is our stronghold. The rest of Europe is where we're heading next.

Stora is the operating system for modern self storage: online bookings, payments, facility management, reporting, and automation in one platform. We started as operators ourselves, and that's still how we think. If you want to own a product operators depend on every day, in a company genuinely rethinking how it builds, this is it.

Why this role matters

We have a strong product team, great engineers, and a growing product. The bottleneck isn't ideas or execution capacity. It's people who can hold the full picture at once.

What the business needs, what the customer actually experiences, what's technically feasible, what to cut when time is short, and knowing when to slow down. Making good calls across all of it. That's the job.

We've shortened the loop between insight and shipped product by stripping out the layers that slow good judgement down. The quality bar didn't move. This role exists to keep doing that. It carries real ownership from day one, and the scope grows as Stora does.

The surface you'd own

This is the product operators live in every day, and the storefront their own customers book through. You're designing for two users at once: the operator running the business, and the end customer renting the unit. Getting that B2B2C experience right is a genuine craft problem. It's a broad, central surface, and it's heavy on UX.

Concretely, the surface includes:

  • Core workflows: customers, units, tenancies, access

  • Roles, permissions, account structure

  • Operational reporting: occupancy, utilisation, activity

  • The internal data layer: event tracking, core models, metric definitions

  • The growth surface: storefront, checkout, the lead → booking funnel

If an operator uses it daily, or relies on it to understand their business, it sits with this team.

How we actually work

We've changed how product gets built at Stora. This is how we operate now.

Designers work directly in the codebase. Engineers and product people work closely together from the start. We use AI genuinely: to explore, prototype and move faster. The work gets closer to reality, sooner.

If you're at a company that talks about moving faster but runs the same process it did three years ago, this will feel different. We're not done evolving how we work, and this person will have real scope to shape that.

What you'll do

  • Own a problem space end-to-end, from understanding the customer need to something live in the product

  • Work across both sides of the experience: operator back office and end-customer storefront

  • Work directly with engineering leads. Close collaboration, not handoff

  • Make scope calls. Know what to cut, what's fundamental, what can wait

  • Work with or without a designer, depending on the problem. What matters is the outcome

  • Stay close to customers, talk to operators, understand how they run their businesses, bring that into every decision

  • Shape how we work. The process isn't fixed. If something's slowing things down, fix it

What you'll bring

  • Real product experience at a SaaS company. You've owned features or problem spaces end-to-end and shipped things people use. Roughly 2+ years, though we care more about the evidence than the number

  • A builder by instinct. You make things: side projects, tools, a company you tried to start. We'd rather see someone who ships than someone who only plans

  • A design or engineering past works too. You may have come from design, engineering, or somewhere else entirely. Designers and people who've started their own things tend to do well here

  • Great product taste. You can tell the difference between a solution that works and one that just ships

  • You define it yourself. You don't need everything defined to make progress

  • Real design sense. Strong enough to contribute or push back, which matters a lot on a surface this UX-heavy

  • AI-native. You use AI as a natural part of how you think and work. Not waiting to be shown how

This role is not for you if

  • You need a detailed brief before you can start

  • You've only ever worked inside someone else's process and haven't shipped anything of your own

  • You think good product work stops before it ships

  • You go quiet when a problem is ambiguous instead of pushing into it

Why Stora

  • A category-defining surface to own. Self storage software is wide open, and the core experience is the heart of it. You set the direction here, you don't inherit it.

  • Work that ships, and that you feel. We've stripped out the layers between insight and shipped product. What you build reaches operators in weeks, not quarters.

  • A team that builds differently. Designers in the codebase, AI used for real, process that bends when it should. Small team, outsized impact.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary

  • Share options

  • Remote across the UK & Europe, or hybrid from our Belfast office

  • 35 days holiday

  • Private health insurance (for you + family)

  • Company pension plan

  • Apple hardware

  • Learning & development support

Next steps

When you apply, we'll ask for a link to something you've made — a product, a side project, a repo, a tool you built because something annoyed you. It doesn't need to be polished, successful, or related to storage. We just want to see that you build. Please include one.

We're reviewing applications as they come in and will be in touch quickly if it looks like a match.

We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.

About the job

The Professional Services team helps Contentsquare customers turn digital experience data into measurable business outcomes. As a Senior Strategic Consultant, you will be a senior, client-facing consultant responsible for delivering strategic, analytical, and enablement services to enterprise customers. You will combine consulting expertise, project management, digital analytics knowledge, and Contentsquare expertise to help customers understand their digital experience, prioritize opportunities, and take action.

You will work across two types of engagements:

 

  1. One-off consulting missions, where you lead and deliver a defined project (analysis, workshop, training..)

  2. Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. You will manage the service roadmap, coordinate contributors, maintain delivery momentum, and proactively ensure that the customer receives value from the available services.

You will operate as a trusted advisor to customer teams, including operational stakeholders, analytics teams, technical teams, and senior or economic buyers. You will work closely with Customer Success Manager and Sales but also all your Professional Services colleagues such as Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants..

This role is ideal for someone who combines the structure and client leadership of a senior consultant with the curiosity and practical fluency of a digital analytics power user.




What you’ll do

  • Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and become a reliable advisor on their digital experience and analytics priorities.

  • Communicate complex analytical or technical concepts clearly to audiences with different levels of expertise.

  • Identify opportunities to improve customer processes, measurement practices, data flows, or use of digital analytics.

    • Improve how we work

  • Use artificial intelligence responsibly to improve preparation, analysis, delivery quality, and internal processes.

  • Stay current with developments in digital analytics, artificial intelligence, data ecosystems, and customer experience measurement.

  • Share knowledge with other consultants and help strengthen the capabilities of the wider Professional Services team.

    •

  • Demonstrated experience managing projects or workstreams from discovery through delivery.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team


Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

 

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors.

You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers.

You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing.


Functions of the Role

  • Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices, developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility.

  • Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight, identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping.

  • Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure, creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments.

  • Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift.

  • Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers, providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield.

  • Build scalable characterisation processes, establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams.

  • Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology, bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales.

  • We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation.


Experience - Essentials


  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline.

  • 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment.

  • Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing.

  • Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution.

  • A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in:

  • Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping.

  • Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems.

  • Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis.

  • Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation.

  • Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies.


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team

  • Competitive salary and share options scheme

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Group private medical insurance scheme

  • Life Assurance

  • Cycle-to-work Scheme 

  • Central London location


EEO Statement

Quantum Motion is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate based on age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, colour, religion, disability status, marital status, pregnancy, gender reassignment or any other protected characteristics covered by the Equality Act 2010.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
About BLUE

BLUE is a specialist global B2B communications consultancy for organisations operating in complex, high-value industries - such as maritime, marine leisure, energy and carbon markets. Since 2008, we've turned market expertise into influence and impact, helping clients lead conversations, shape markets and unlock growth.

Our credibility comes from deep immersion, not observation. We get close enough to our clients' businesses to understand what motivates them — and what keeps them awake at night — so we can operate as true consultants, not just a delivery team. It's why our clients stay, and why we've built long-term partnerships across some of the most complex, high-value industries there are.

The role

We're looking for an Account Executive to be an integral, client-facing part of our account teams — the person who knows the status of every action and keeps the whole programme moving. You'll drive activity across your accounts, own the calendar, WIP and reporting, and build a genuine understanding of your clients, their sectors and the wider market.

It's a role for someone at the start of their PR career who wants to learn fast, get properly stuck in, and grow into a trusted communications professional — all while living BLUE's values as a true brand ambassador.

Tasks

Account management & reporting

  • Know the status of every action — own the calendar of activity, WIP and client reporting, including BLUE's Impact Report template
  • Track, collate, analyse and evaluate coverage, and keep account documents correctly named, filed and formatted to BLUE's brand templates
  • Develop and sustain client relationships day-to-day, and support the senior team with tactical delivery of PR strategy

Media monitoring & relations

  • Monitor client and BLUE sector media, spotting opportunities for clients to comment or feed into messaging and articles of interest
  • Issue press releases and pitches to targeted contacts, following up with key media by phone and email
  • Own and maintain BLUE's core media lists, and build journalist relationships through regular contact

Writing & content

  • Draft press releases and shorter-form content such as blogs and editorial, backed by research and interviews
  • Draft first-draft speaker abstracts and media briefs
  • Maintain client social media channels on social media channels and proofread materials with a close eye for detail

Social media & culture

  • Monitor client and competitor social channels, and support larger social content projects alongside BLUE's digital team
  • Live by and promote BLUE's brand values, contribute content for BLUE's own LinkedIn, website and socials, and support with general administration as needed
  • Attend external networking events for your own development and to promote the BLUE brand, spotting commercial opportunities as you go

Requirements

Essential

  • Some PR or communications experience, either agency, in-house or via a placement/internship, or a relevant degree with demonstrable interest in the industry
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with a close eye for detail and accuracy
  • Strong organisational skills, able to manage multiple tasks, deadlines and priorities at once
  • A proactive, can-do attitude and genuine curiosity about clients, their sectors and the wider market
  • A confident communicator, comfortable speaking with clients and journalists

Desirable

  • Experience in, or genuine curiosity about, the marine, renewable energy or wider sustainability sectors
  • Familiarity with media monitoring/coverage tools and social media management
  • Experience drafting press releases, pitches or social copy

Benefits

  • Hybrid working, with a 4pm Friday finish encouraged!
  • Dog friendly offices
  • A charity donation made in your name on your birthday and the day off
  • Employee of the Quarter recognition and length of service bonus
  • Additional annual leave after 2 years
  • New Business commission scheme
  • Employee assistance scheme
  • Two centrally located UK offices, fully stocked with food and drink
  • Regular team socials, from dragon boat racing to scavenger hunts
  • Perk Box access and discounts
  • Salary sacrifice pension scheme
  • ‘Work from anywhere’ policy (2 weeks, after 1 year of service)
  • A genuine stake in a growing, purpose-led consultancy
  • Opportunity for international travel and events
  • Weekly T@3 for knowledge sharing
  • Cycle to work scheme

jobs.title: (Senior) Accountant/Buchhalter*in (all genders) in Berlin
jobs.description:
We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.

Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus.

Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum.

Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf.

Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet.

Die Rolle

Wir suchen zur Verstärkung unseres Finance Teams eine*n (Senior) Accountant/Buchhalter*in (all genders), der/die die Belegbuchung unserer Gesellschaften durchführt und somit für die korrekte Führung der Bücher sorgt.
Gemeinsam mit den bestehenden Accountants trägst du dazu bei, dass nötige Zahlungen in allen Unternehmensbereichen korrekt getätigt und verbucht werden. Der Einsatz moderner Software-Lösungen beschleunigt die Prozesse. Du nimmst eine zentrale Rolle im Unternehmen ein und stehst im ständigen Austausch mit den anderen Unternehmensbereichen.

What You'll Do

  • Du kontrollierst und verbuchst sämtliche Geschäftsvorfälle in Datev.
  • Du bist für die ordnungsgemäße Erfassung der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung zuständig und betreust die Anlagen- und Bankbuchhaltung.
  • Du kontrollierst die Zahlungseingänge und bist verantwortlich für die Erstellung von Zahlläufen.
  • Du übermittelst die Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung und Bettensteuer.
  • Du übernimmst Abstimmarbeiten im Sachkonten-, Debitoren- und Kreditorenbereich, sowie Intercompany.
  • Du leistest vorbereitende Tätigkeiten und arbeitest bei der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB mit.
  • Du bearbeitest und buchst Kreditkartenabrechnungen über Pleo.
  • Du optimierst proaktiv die Prozesse, inklusive der Erhöhung des Digitalisierungsgrades.

What Makes You a Fit

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung sowie bereits mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung
  • Du verfügst über Kenntnisse des HGBs sowie des Umsatzsteuergesetzes
  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit der Buchhaltungssoftware Datev mit
  • Idealerweise hast du eine Weiterbildung zum IHK geprüften Bilanzbuchhalter
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office Programmen, insbesondere Excel und bist grundlegend offen für eine digitale Arbeitsumgebung
  • Du verfügst über eine selbstständige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, bist aber auch Teamfähig und schaust gern mal über den Tellerrand hinaus
  • Du hast ein Auge für Verbesserungspotenzial und das Interesse den eigenen Bereich mitzugestalten und voranzubringen
  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau (C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (B1)
  • Du nutzt digitale Tools mit Leichtigkeit, erkennst Potenziale und und bist begeistert davon, wie KI den Arbeitsalltag effizienter gestalten kann. Falls du dich nicht in allen Punkten der oben genannten Profilbeschreibung wiederfindest aber trotzdem Interesse an der Position hast, bewirb dich gerne dennoch bei uns. Wir freuen uns über vielfältige Lebensläufe und Profile.

The Environment

Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.

Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet.

Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt.

What We Offer

Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst.

Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. Vieles ist bereits dabei.

Die Details stellen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch vor.

Next Steps

Wenn dich diese Position anspricht, freuen wir uns darauf, mehr über deine Erfahrungen und deine Perspektive zu erfahren.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf.

Du hast Fragen? Melde dich gerne bei Naomi unter oder +49 1579 2465851

jobs.title: Senior Manager SEA (m/w/d)

emetriq, Teil der Deutschen Telekom AG, bietet datengetriebene Online-Advertising-Lösungen und setzt sich für fairen Datenzugang als Treibstoff für Innovation und Vielfalt ein. Du steuerst unsere SEA-Maßnahmen fachlich, hinterfragst bestehende Kampagnenstrukturen und Prozesse und entwickelst sie gemeinsam mit  den operativen Kampagnenteams weiter, um Conversion, Effizienz und Wachstum nachhaltig zu steigern.

Wie du uns helfen kannst

  • Fachliche Steuerung der Umsetzung:
    Du übersetzt strategische Performance-Ziele in klare Anforderungen, priorisierst Maßnahmen und begleitest die operative Umsetzung im Austausch mit beteiligten Partner:innen und Fachbereichen.

  • Übergreifende SEA-Verantwortung:
    Du steuerst performanceorientierte SEA-Maßnahmen übergreifend und sorgst dafür, dass Ziele, Planung, operative Umsetzung und Optimierung wirksam ineinandergreifen.

  • Operative Qualitätssicherung:
    Du prüfst Account- und Kampagnenstrukturen, Keywords, Anzeigen, Zielgruppen, Budgets und Gebotsstrategien und bewertest, ob die Umsetzung die definierten Performance-Ziele unterstützt.

  • Analyse und Weiterentwicklung:
    Du analysierst Performance-Daten, hinterfragst bestehende Maßnahmen und Prozesse und entwickelst konkrete Verbesserungsansätze zur Steigerung von Effizienz, Conversion und Wachstum.

  • Strategische Beratung:
    Du berätst interne Stakeholder zu Kampagnenarchitektur, Keyword- und Budgetstrategien, Automatisierung, Messbarkeit und kanalübergreifenden Fragestellungen mit Schwerpunkt auf Performance-Marketing. Dabei führst du bestehende Maßnahmen und Prozesse nicht einfach unreflektiert fort, sondern hinterfragst sie konstruktiv und optimierst oder entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.

  • Testing und Innovation:
    Du entwickelst neue Testansätze für Kampagnentypen, Anzeigen, Landingpages, Zielgruppen und Gebotsstrategien und bewertest gemeinsam mit den Kampagnenteams deren Wirkung auf Conversion, Effizienz und Skalierung.

  • Kanalübergreifende Perspektive und Tracking:
    Du betrachtest SEA im Zusammenspiel mit weiteren Kanälen und entwickelst daraus integrierte Empfehlungen entlang der Kommunikations- und Performance-Ziele.

  • Präsentation und Stakeholder-Management:
    Du bereitest Ergebnisse und Empfehlungen verständlich auf und präsentierst sie sicher gegenüber Entscheidungsträger:innen und internen Fachbereichen.

  • Standards und Prozesse:
    Du entwickelst bestehende Arbeitsweisen, Qualitätsstandards und Prozesse weiter und sorgst dafür, dass erfolgreiche Ansätze nachhaltig im Team verankert werden.


Was du mitbringst

  • Fundierte SEA-Expertise:
    Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Suchmaschinenmarketing und kennst die Anforderungen an Planung, Steuerung und Optimierung komplexer performanceorientierter SEA-Maßnahmen.

  • Operatives Plattformverständnis:
    Du kennst die operative Kampagnensteuerung aus eigener Erfahrung und kannst Accountstrukturen, Set-ups und Optimierungsentscheidungen in Google Ads und Microsoft Advertising fachlich sicher beurteilen.

  • Strategisches Denken:
    Du ordnest Performance-Daten und operative Fragestellungen strategisch in einen größeren Zusammenhang ein, hinterfragst bestehende Maßnahmen und leitest daraus fundierte Empfehlungen und Weiterentwicklungen ab.

  • Kritischer Blick:
    Du hinterfragst bestehende Maßnahmen und Prozesse konstruktiv, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und treibst deren Weiterentwicklung mit eigenen Impulsen voran.

  • Steuerungs- und Beratungskompetenz:
    Du kannst fachliche Anforderungen klar formulieren, operative Teams zielgerichtet begleiten und unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf Augenhöhe zu einer gemeinsamen Lösung führen.

  • Trackingverständnis:
    Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Conversion-Tracking, Attribution, GA4 und idealerweise Google Tag Manager mit.

  • Kommunikationsstärke:
    Du kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln, Empfehlungen nachvollziehbar begründen und sicher vor unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner:innen präsentieren.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Organisation:
    Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und behältst auch bei komplexen Themen, Prioritäten und Stakeholdern den Überblick.

  • Sprachkenntnisse:
    Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.

Was uns besonders macht

Wir bei emetriq sind ein Team von Experten, das mit Leidenschaft und Fachkenntnissen zusammenarbeitet, um das Unternehmen und uns selbst weiterzuentwickeln. Unsere Werte basieren auf Vertrauen, Agilität, Selbstorganisation und Eigenverantwortung – ohne starre Hierarchien, dafür mit klaren Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Mut zur Veränderung, Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit prägen unsere Kultur. Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere Motivation und Begeisterung teilen.

Unsere Benefits

jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)

Du kennst den Unterschied zwischen einer geschalteten Anzeige und einer funktionierenden Recruiting-Strategie? Und du willst nicht nur eine Position im Haus besetzen, sondern die Personalgewinnung ganzer Unternehmen verantworten? Dann lies weiter.

Im klassischen Inhouse-Recruiting arbeitest du an den Stellen, die dir zugewiesen werden, mit dem Budget, das jemand anderes verhandelt hat. Bei uns läuft es umgekehrt: Du entscheidest, welche Unternehmen du gewinnst, wie ihre Recruiting-Strategie aussieht und über welche Kanäle die Besetzung läuft. Beratung, Umsetzung und Ergebnis liegen in einer Hand – deiner.

Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung im Zentrum von Bielefeld. Wir machen Arbeitgeber sichtbar und liefern ihnen planbar passende Bewerbungen – über datengetriebene Kampagnen statt Zufallstreffer. Fachkräftemangel und demografische Entwicklung lassen diesen Markt jedes Jahr weiter wachsen.

Deine Verantwortung

Strategie und Beratung

  • Du analysierst, warum die Personalgewinnung eines Unternehmens nicht liefert – Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Kanäle, Prozessgeschwindigkeit.

  • Daraus entwickelst du eine belastbare Recruiting-Strategie und stellst sie den Entscheidern vor.

  • Du gewinnst neue Kunden aktiv: über Telefon, Direktansprache und Empfehlungen.

Kampagnen und Besetzung

  • Du planst Recruiting-Kampagnen, steuerst sie über die Laufzeit und justierst anhand der Zahlen nach.

  • Du prüfst eingehende Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche zur Vorauswahl und gestaltest eine Candidate Experience, die im Gedächtnis bleibt.

  • Bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung bleibt das Projekt in deiner Hand.

Daten und Weiterentwicklung

  • Du arbeitest sauber im CRM, kennst deine Kennzahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

  • Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung schärfst du unsere Methodik weiter.

Dein Profil

  • Recruiting-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Zielgruppenansprache, Kanalauswahl und Prozessgestaltung zusammenwirken – ob aus Agentur, Personaldienstleistung oder Inhouse.

  • Beratungsstärke: Du triffst mit deinen Fragen den Kern, denkst in Lösungen und erklärst sie so, dass Entscheider mitgehen.

  • Vertriebsbereitschaft: Neue Kunden zu gewinnen gehört für dich dazu und schreckt dich nicht ab.

  • Zahlenaffinität: Du liest Kampagnendaten, erkennst Muster und handelst danach.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du steuerst dich selbst, hältst nach Rückschlägen Kurs und misst dich an Ergebnissen.

  • Zum Hintergrund: Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg – wir schauen auf Können und Antrieb, nicht auf den Titel. Erfahrung im Recruiting ist willkommen, aber nichts, was wir dir nicht beibringen könnten.

Unser Angebot

  • Vergütung ohne Obergrenze: Fixgehalt als sichere Basis, dazu eine Provision, die nicht gedeckelt ist.

  • Unbefristet vom ersten Tag an: Wir planen langfristig – in einem Markt, der stabil wächst.

  • Klarer Entwicklungspfad: Recruiter, Junior Consultant, Senior Consultant. Das Tempo bestimmst du.

  • Einarbeitung mit Struktur: Umfassendes Onboarding, Trainings zu Recruiting, Beratung und Vertrieb, dazu feste Feedbackrunden.

  • Ausstattung auf Niveau: Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman-Miller-Stühle, Apple-Hardware – mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.

  • Fitness auf unsere Kosten: Premium-Mitgliedschaft im Studio deiner Wahl.

  • Gut versorgt: Siebträgerkaffee von Julius Meinl, ausgesuchte Tees, flexibles Mittagsangebot über Meyer Menü.

  • Flache Hierarchie: Leistungsorientiert und kollegial, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

Der Ablauf

  1. Bewerben in zwei Minuten – Lebenslauf genügt, kein Anschreiben nötig.

  2. Telefonat zum Kennenlernen – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

  3. Persönliches Gespräch in unserem Büro in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.

Wenn du Recruiting nicht abarbeiten, sondern gestalten willst: Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

  • Build state-of-the-art models: Focus on model performance and probability calibration. Design rigorous backtesting frameworks to prevent data leakage and evaluate performance against historical market baselines.

  • Develop Market Logic: Create the mathematical rules and probabilistic derivations that translate baseline win probabilities into complex derivative markets (handicaps, totals, player props).

  • Deploy real-time production systems: Ensure your models are seamlessly translated into production-grade pipelines and microservices.

Your skills will include

Required

  • Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in data science, quantitative research, or statistical modelling.

  • Advanced Mathematical Foundations: Deep, intuitive understanding of probability, statistics, and machine learning theory.

Nice to Have

  • Esports Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of competitive esports (CS2, Dota 2, LoL), the underlying game mechanics, and the competitive meta.

Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth.

Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network.

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.

As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business.

  • As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem.
  • You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities.
  • You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems.
  • You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability.
  • You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly.
  • You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.
  • You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes.


Skills

  • Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus).
  • Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics.
  • Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation.

jobs.title: IT Administrator / (Senior) IT Administrator
jobs.description:
Apex.AI is an international software company developing safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility and autonomous systems. Our technology enables companies to build software-defined vehicles and intelligent machines faster, safer, and more efficiently. 

We are looking for a hands-on IT Administrator / (Senior) IT Administrator to take ownership of the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of our IT environment in Germany while supporting our international teams. 

This is a highly practical role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, administering systems, supporting users, and continuously improving IT infrastructure. You will work across Linux and macOS endpoints, identity and access management, cloud services, networks, security tooling, and on-premises infrastructure. 

You will be a key point of contact for IT topics in our Munich office and work closely with Engineering, DevOps, HR, and other business functions. 

In addition to your core IT responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to develop your knowledge of Information Security and compliance, including ISO 27001 and TISAX. Previous compliance experience is welcome but not required—we are looking for someone who is interested in learning and growing in this area. 

As Apex.AI grows, this role offers the opportunity to take on broader ownership and help shape the future of our IT function. 

 
This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in Germany is required.

What You’ll Do

Hands-on IT Administration 

  • Own and manage the day-to-day operation of our cloud and on-premises IT environment.  

  • Administer and support Linux and macOS endpoints throughout their lifecycle.  

  • Manage MDM, IAM, user accounts, permissions, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Administer cloud-based email, collaboration, and file-storage services.  

  • Manage employee access across internal systems and business applications.  

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot wired and wireless networks.  

  • Manage VPN solutions, network segmentation, policies, and access rules.  

  • Administer and maintain on-premises and cloud-based servers.  

  • Manage endpoint security solutions, including EDR/antivirus, patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Implement and maintain integrations between different IT systems.  

  • Automate repetitive IT administration tasks wherever possible.  

  • Monitor systems and proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact users.  

IT Support & Service Delivery 

  • Be a primary point of contact for IT support for employees in our Munich office and provide remote support to colleagues in other locations.  

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, endpoint, network, account, and access issues.  

  • Manage IT support requests and ensure issues are resolved efficiently.  

  • Set up laptops, accounts, permissions, and required applications for new employees.  

  • Execute IT onboarding and offboarding for employees and contractors.  

  • Manage IT hardware inventory and device lifecycle.  

  • Maintain clear and useful technical documentation.  

  • Help create a reliable and user-friendly IT environment where employees can work effectively with minimal friction.  

IT Security & Compliance 

You will have the opportunity to learn how to manage ISMS based on ISO 27001 and TISAX frameworks. We are looking for someone eager to develop in this area. 

You will: 

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of technical security controls.  

  • Help maintain IT documentation, policies, procedures, asset inventories, and access records.  

  • Support evidence collection and technical preparation for ISO 27001 and TISAX audits.  

  • Work with internal and external stakeholders on Information Security topics.  

  • Support vulnerability management, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and security incident readiness.  

  • Help investigate and resolve IT security incidents.  

  • Gradually develop your knowledge of our ISMS and security/compliance requirements.  

  • Contribute ideas for improving the security and resilience of our IT environment.  

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement 

  • Work closely with Engineering and DevOps on infrastructure, access, networking, and security topics.  

  • Support business applications used by HR, Sales, Finance, Legal, and other teams.  

  • Work with IT vendors and service providers when required.  

  • Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to our IT environment.  

  • Support the secure adoption of AI tools and emerging technologies.  

  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and simplification.  


What you bring

  • Several years of hands-on experience as an IT Administrator, System Administrator, IT Engineer, or similar role.  

  • Strong hands-on experience administering Linux and/or macOS environments, with a willingness to become proficient across both.  

  • Experience with endpoint and device management, including MDM, centralized patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Experience with IAM, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Experience administering cloud-based productivity and collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.  

  • Solid networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, Wi-Fi, VPNs, VLANs, and firewalls.  

  • Experience administering servers and working with on-premises infrastructure.  

  • Understanding of endpoint security, backups, monitoring, and logging.  

  • Basic scripting or automation skills using Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.  

  • A practical troubleshooting mindset and willingness to investigate problems independently.  

  • Comfortable supporting users directly—from simple endpoint issues to more complex infrastructure problems.  

  • Ability to document technical processes clearly.  

  • Fluent English; German language skills are a must (C1 level).  

    • Most importantly, you: 

    • Enjoy being hands-on and solving technical problems yourself.  

    • Take ownership instead of simply escalating issues to someone else.  

    • Are comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask for help.  

    • Enjoy working with highly technical software engineers and learning from subject-matter experts.  

    • Are curious about new technologies and continuously develop your skills.  

    • Want to broaden your experience beyond traditional IT administration into Information Security, ISO 27001, and TISAX.  


Nice to have

  • Experience with JumpCloud or similar MDM/IAM platforms.  

  • Experience with Google Workspace administration.  

  • Experience with AWS services such as EC2, EBS, IAM, or RDS.  

  • Experience with EDR, vulnerability management, monitoring, or logging solutions.  

  • Experience supporting developer or engineering environments.  

  • Familiarity with CI/CD infrastructure and version-control systems.  

  • Previous exposure to ISO 27001, TISAX, ISMS, or security audits.  

  • IT or security certifications such as CompTIA, ITIL, CCNA, or similar.  

  • Interest or experience in AI/LLM technologies and their secure use within an enterprise environment.  


Why Apex.AI

  • Take real ownership of a modern IT environment rather than simply managing external providers.  

  • Work closely with world-class software engineers developing cutting-edge platforms for autonomous and software-defined systems.  

  • Gain hands-on exposure to an engineering-focused environment spanning Linux, macOS, cloud, networking, security, and developer infrastructure.  

  • Grow your Information Security expertise through practical exposure to ISO 27001, TISAX, security controls, audits, and ISMS processes.  

  • Have a direct impact on how our IT environment evolves as the company grows.  

  • Work in an international, engineering-driven culture where technical curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.  

  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for professional and career development.  

About Apex.AI

Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

  • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
  • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

  • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
  • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

Mytheresa is one of the leading global digital luxury shopping platforms. Our unique digital experience is based on a sharp focus on high-end luxury shoppers, exclusive product and content offerings, leading technology and analytical platforms as well as high quality service operations.

Since January 2021 we are a listed company on the New York Stock Exchange. More than 1,200 employees from over 70 countries work passionately to provide the best shopping experience.

Creating a strong as well as a diverse and inclusive team is essential for Mytheresa. For us your expertise and motivation matter more than your individual walk of life. Mytheresa ensures a fast and equal hiring process.

To support team SEO we are searching for an Online Marketing Manager SEO (f/m/d) to be based in our Munich office.

Tasks

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Technical Excellence: You lead technical SEO audits and manage site architecture to ensure optimal crawling and indexing for our global platform.
  • AI Innovation: You identify and implement AI driven solutions to improve operational efficiency and stay ahead of industry trends.
  • Global Coordination: You support the SEO strategy for our international storefronts and ensure that technical standards are met across all regions.
  • Cross functional Collaboration: You work closely with Product and Engineering departments to prioritize technical SEO enhancements and translate them into actionable requirements.
  • Performance Monitoring: You analyze organic search performance using enterprise level tools and provide data driven recommendations for growt

Requirements

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experience: You have four+ years of experience in SEO with a strong track record in e-commerce or a similar fast paced environment.
  • Technical Skills: You have: Strong understanding of HTML and JavaScript SEO. Hands-on experience with crawling, indexing, site architecture, structured data, and international SEO. Experience with technical SEO and monitoring tools, including Screaming Frog, Oncrawl, Google Search Console, Semrush and similar platforms.
  • AI Affinity: You have a strong interest in leveraging AI technologies to optimize SEO workflows and improve data analysis.
  • Communication: You are a fluent English speaker with the ability to communicate complex technical topics to various stakeholders. Additional language skills in Chinese, Korean or Arabic are considered a significant advantage.
  • Analytical Mindset: You enjoy working with large datasets and have a proactive approach to solving technical challenges.

Benefits

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Up to 32 days of holiday, depending on the length of service, starting with 28 days
  • Mobile office with up to 20% of your total contracted hours (job and position permitting)
  • 10 days/year of mobile office abroad in EU-countries (job and position permitting)
  • Language courses
  • Staff discount of up to 30%
  • Company pension scheme
  • Discounted membership for selected sports platforms & gyms
  • Discounted travel card
  • Individual support on mental health & well-being (e.g. compatibility work and family life)
  • Social Day
  • Employee Share Purchase Plan

jobs.title: Ingénieur.e : Évaluation de la susceptibilité à l’injection de fautes des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles – CDD 12 mois
jobs.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant qu’Ingénieur.e, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche, formation, et innovation ; affecté au Centre Microélectronique de Provence. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez passion scientifique et intérêt pour la recherche appliquée.

Le département Systèmes et Architectures Sécurisés (SAS), du Centre Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), étudie la sécurité des composants électroniques et des données qu’ils contiennent (tels que des clefs de cryptographie, des logiciels, des blocs de propriété intellectuelle, des données en mémoires, etc.) vis-à-vis de manipulations frauduleuses couramment appelées “attaques” matérielles. Les enseignants-chercheurs du département SAS contribuent au développement de protections matérielles, logicielles, et cryptographiques contre ces attaques, et plus largement à la proposition de solutions de sécurité pour les objets mobiles.

Le département SAS est associé au CEA Leti dans une équipe commune, l’EC SAS, comprenant actuellement 32 personnes.

 

Le recrutement d’un.e Ingénieur.e de recherche en Sécurité Matérielle s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet SecMemPCM financé par la Région Sud. Votre mission est une mission de recherche sur le sujet de la susceptibilité à l’injection de fautes des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles.

 ·         Vous assurez un travail de recherche sur la susceptibilité des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles émergentes (eNVM) aux attaques matérielles, et plus particulièrement aux attaques par injection de fautes.

·         Vous menez des essais expérimentaux de caractérisation du comportement de divers types de eNVM face aux attaques par injection de fautes. Vous analysez les résultats afin de comprendre et modéliser les mécanismes associés.

·         Vous rendez compte des activités et des résultats qui relèvent des missions dont vous aurez la charge.

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à conduire un travail de recherche sera essentielle pour réussir.

 


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalent, ou d’une thèse.

Vous avez des compétences scientifiques en Microélectronique et/ou en sécurité matérielle.

Et idéalement :

·      Avec une expérience dans le domaine de la sécurité matérielle et des techniques d’injection de fautes.

·      Junior accepté : Oui

·      Une maîtrise de l’anglais (niveau C1).

 

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

•           Vous êtes titulaire d’une thèse en microélectronique et/ou sécurité matérielle.

•           Vous possédez une expérience pratique des techniques d’injection de fautes.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

·           Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

·           Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

·           Une qualité de vie incomparable : 46 /49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

jobs.title: Senior Berater (w/m/d) – Intelligent Document Processing / Input Management
jobs.description:
Pentadoc sucht erfahrene Senior Berater (w/m/d) im Bereich Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) und Input Management (IM) mit dem Schwerpunkt im deutschen Privatversicherungsmarkt.

IDP ist die nächste Generation des Input Managements und revolutioniert die Verarbeitung von Geschäftsdokumenten. Es nutzt fortschrittliche Technologien wie:

  • Künstliche Intelligenz (KI)
  • Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache (NLP)
  • Cloud Computing

IDP-Lösungen wandeln unstrukturierte Daten in strukturierte, verwertbare Informationen um. Sie können auch komplexe Dokumente identifizieren, klassifizieren, relevante Daten extrahieren und ermöglichen so einen höheren Automatisierungsgrad.

Unsere Anforderungen

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Digitalen Transformation mit ausgeprägtem IDP- bzw. IM Schwerpunkt
  • Erfahrung in der Technologieberatung, insbesondere mit Cloud-basierten IDP-Lösungen
  • Erfahrung in der Verantwortung von Inputmanagement-Projekten und Führung agiler Teams
  • Projektverantwortung und erfolgreiche Implementierungen von IDP-Systemen
  • Vorteilhaft: Erfahrung in der Versicherungs- oder Gesundheitsbranche

Deine verantworteten Themen

  • Beratung zu Cloud-basierten IDP-Plattformen und Archivlösungen
  • Aufzeigen von KI-Potenzialen im Inputmanagement
  • Planung und Durchführung von IDP-Kundenprojekten
  • Integration von IDP-Lösungen in bestehende Geschäftsprozesse
  • Begleitung von Veränderungsmaßnahmen im Inputmanagement

Dein neuer Arbeitsalltag

  • Du übst deine Tätigkeit in einem dezentral organisierten Unternehmen aus, das heißt, dein Hauptarbeitsplatz ist zu 80-90% dein Home-Office am Wohnsitz
  • Entsprechend deiner Verantwortung im Projekt sowie dem Projektbedarf angemessen nimmst du eigenverantwortlich auch Vor-Ort-Tätigkeiten wahr.
  • Deinen Arbeitsalltag strukturierst du im Rahmen deiner Aufgaben selbstorganisiert und selbstbestimmt.

Du erhältst

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein Fixum aus 14 Monatsgehältern kombiniert mit einem variablen Gehaltsbestandteil, das an unseren gemeinsamen Gesamterfolg der Pentadoc Gruppe gekoppelt ist.
  • Mobilität: Firmenwagen, Bahncard und auf Wunsch auch ein Firmenfahrrad für deine berufliche und private Nutzung.
  • Hochwertige IT-Ausstattung: Business-Class Ausstattung mit Laptop, Handy, Zubehör und Zuschüssen für deinen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz zuhause
  • Firmenkreditkarte: Eigenständigkeit statt Freigabehölle – Du buchst selbst, was du brauchst, wenn du es brauchst.
  • Betriebliche Gesundheitsmaßnahmen: Du profitierst von betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, den Vorteilsprogramm ‚WellPass‘ und Integration von Maßnahmen im Arbeitsalltag

Wir bieten dir eine innovative Unternehmenskultur mit remote-Arbeit, Gestaltungsfreiheit, Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und der Chance, die Zukunft der intelligenten Dokumentenverarbeitung mitzugestalten.

Infos dazu findest du auf unserer Webseite - oder noch besser: Wir unterhalten uns einfach in einem ersten Kennenlerngespräch.

Wir freuen uns über deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung (Gehaltsvorstellung, CV, Projektnachweise) und den anschießenden Austausch mit Dir!

jobs.title: Recruiter (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Recruiter (m/w/d)

Du bist ehrgeizig, smart und willst nicht jahrelang warten, bis man dir Verantwortung gibt? Dann lies weiter.

Bei den großen Personaldienstleistern lernst du erst monatelang Recruiting, bevor du überhaupt an den Vertrieb darfst. Bei uns nicht. Als Recruiter (m/w/d) übernimmst du von Anfang an den kompletten Zyklus: Du gewinnst Kunden, berätst sie strategisch – und setzt die Recruiting-Projekte anschließend selbst um. Eine Rolle, doppelte Kompetenz, volle Verantwortung für deinen Erfolg.

Wir sind eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung mitten in Bielefeld und helfen Unternehmen, ihre Arbeitgebermarke zu stärken und planbar qualifizierte Talente zu gewinnen – mit datenbasiertem Recruiting und strukturiertem Vertrieb. Und wir arbeiten in einem Markt, der durch Fachkräftemangel und demografischen Wandel jedes Jahr weiter wächst.

Profitiere als Recruiter (m/w/d) von unseren Benefits:

  • Attraktives Fixgehalt + ungedeckelte Bonuszahlungen: Deine Leistung entscheidet, was am Monatsende auf deinem Konto landet – nach oben offen.
  • Unbefristete Festanstellung: Wir bauen langfristig auf dich – Zukunftssicherheit in einer Branche, die durch die Digitalisierung und den Fachkräftemangel stetig wächst.
  • Echte 360°-Entwicklung: Du baust dir Kompetenz in Vertrieb UND Recruiting auf – das Profil, das im Markt am gefragtesten ist. Klarer Entwicklungspfad: Recruiter → Junior Consultant → Senior Consultant.
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding & Coaching: Umfassende Einarbeitung, professionelle Schulungen in Recruiting, Beratung und Vertrieb sowie regelmäßige Feedback-Sessions
  • Premium-Arbeitsplatz: Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman Miller-Stühle, Apple-Technik (MacBook Air/Pro, iMac) – mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
  • Gesundheit im Fokus: Premium-Fitnessvertrag bei einem Studio deiner Wahl.
  • Top-Versorgung im Office: Faema E61-Siebträgermaschine mit Julius Meinl-Kaffee, hochwertige Tees und flexibles Lunch-System von Meyer Menü
  • Teamkultur auf Augenhöhe: Kollegiale, leistungsorientierte Atmosphäre mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung – deine Ideen werden gehört und umgesetzt.

Deine spannenden Aufgaben als Recruiter (m/w/d):

Vertrieb – du gewinnst die Projekte:

  • Du kontaktierst aktiv potenzielle Neukunden per Telefon und Direktansprache und weckst Interesse an unseren digitalen Recruiting-Lösungen.
  • Du analysierst die Recruiting-Herausforderungen der Unternehmen, identifizierst konkreten Handlungsbedarf und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Strategien.
  • Du präsentierst deine Lösungen überzeugend und begleitest den Prozess bis zum Abschluss.

Recruiting – du setzt sie um:

  • Nach Vertragsabschluss steuerst du das Projekt eigenständig weiter – von der Kampagnenplanung bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung.
  • Du koordinierst eingehende Bewerbungen, qualifizierst Kandidaten vor und sorgst für eine professionelle Candidate Experience.

Dein Fundament:

  • Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten sauber im CRM, behältst deine Pipeline im Blick und arbeitest zielorientiert auf deine KPIs hin.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung zusammen und bringst Ideen zur Optimierung unserer Prozesse ein.

Das bringst du idealerweise mit

  • Vertriebsaffinität: Du hast Freude an Akquise und willst aktiv neue Kunden gewinnen – am Telefon, per Video-Call oder persönlich.
  • Beratungsverständnis: Du erkennst Potenziale, stellst die richtigen Fragen und präsentierst Lösungen strukturiert.
  • Menschenkenntnis: Du verstehst sowohl die Unternehmens- als auch die Bewerberperspektive.
  • Eigeninitiative & Leistungswille: Du arbeitest selbstständig, bleibst auch nach einem "Nein" am Ball und willst überdurchschnittliche Ergebnisse erzielen.
  • Wichtig: Ob Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg mit Vertriebserfahrung – uns interessiert nicht dein Lebenslauf, sondern dein Hunger. Recruiting-Vorerfahrung ist ein Plus, kein Muss – das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei.

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As an AI Deployment Strategist, you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral’s AI solutions, working closely with customers from strategic vision to production implementation. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI innovation, and hands-on deployment, ensuring our customers achieve transformative outcomes.

 

You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps, collaborate with the Applied AI team to deliver solutions in production, and ensure seamless transitions from presales to postsales. Your work will directly contribute to customer success, bridging the gap between strategy and execution.

 

This role is ideal for those who thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex business challenges, and are passionate about turning AI potential into real-world impact.

 

What You Will Do

 

Strategic Discovery & Vision Setting

• Lead executive-level workshops to identify business challenges and opportunities where Mistral’s AI can drive step-change improvements.

• Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the “art of the possible” and a clear path to value.

• Collaborate with Account Executives to develop business cases, quantify ROI, and align solutions with customer objectives.

 

AI Solution Design & Deployment

• Architect end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral’s models and platform into customer workflows and technical infrastructure.

• Partner with the Applied AI team to design, prototype, and deploy AI solutions in production, ensuring scalability and impact.

• Own the execution of pilot projects and proofs-of-value, demonstrating the potential of our technology and paving the way for full-scale deployment.

 

Value Realization & Customer Success

• Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding their AI strategy and ensuring they maximize the value of their investment in Mistral.

• Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) tied to business outcomes, and communicate progress to executive sponsors.

• Proactively identify expansion opportunities within accounts, building on initial successes to drive long-term partnerships.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral’s internal teams, synthesizing feedback to influence product and research roadmaps.

• Develop reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks to scale go-to-market efforts and ensure consistent delivery excellence.

• Travel (~30-60%) to foster deep client relationships and support on-site deployment.

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

• 2+ years in a client-facing strategic and technical role (e.g., data science consulting, value engineering, or technical sales).

• You hold a degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, etc.)

• Foundational knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science, with the credibility to advise both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python, JavaScript, or similar) to demonstrate value.

• Strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous challenges into actionable solutions.

• Executive presence and communication skills to influence senior stakeholders (VP, C-level).

• Hands on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python)

• Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a collaborative environment.

• Experience with sales qualification frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC) and value-based selling is a plus.

 

Why This Role Matters You will play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact. By partnering with the Applied AI team, you’ll help turn strategic visions into production-ready solutions, making Mistral an indispensable partner for our customers.

jobs.title: Heartbeat AI Partnerships Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

As part of the Heartbeat Tech domain, you will own our partnerships with hardware manufacturers that connect to Heartbeat AI. You're the person who finds and excites new partners about Heartbeat AI, then negotiates the resulting agreements, and finally makes sure the integration actually gets delivered. But it doesn’t stop there: You will own the relationship long-term and ensure it turns in a true win-win situation.

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Introduction to Role & Team

Bumble Inc. is looking for an Operations Specialist, AI Enablement to join our CX & Trust team. Trust, care, and high-quality experiences are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by improving how our AI-powered customer experience and moderation systems support our community.

You’ll evaluate AI-powered customer interactions and automated moderation decisions against Bumble’s policies, processes, and quality standards, helping us understand where our systems are performing well and where they can improve. Through quality reviews, accurate case labelling, golden-set maintenance, and thoughtful analysis, you’ll help ensure AI-supported decisions are consistent, precise, and grounded in the nuance required to serve our members responsibly. You’ll work closely with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager and colleagues across CX & Trust, taking ownership of high-quality work and demonstrating our Bumble values of Courage, Curiosity, Respect, and Excellence as we reimagine how AI can strengthen trust and care across the member experience.

This role will be based in London and will work in a hybrid model.

What you’ll do

  • Conduct quality reviews of AI-powered customer conversations and automated moderation decisions, assessing their alignment with Bumble’s community policies, operational processes, and quality standards.

  • Analyse policy enforcement gaps and nuanced cases, identifying where automated decisions may be inconsistent, unclear, or misaligned with policy intent and surfacing actionable insights for improvement.

  • Perform accurate case labelling to support AI model training, evaluation pipelines, and ongoing quality benchmarking, demonstrating Excellence through careful and consistent application of established guidance.

  • Review and maintain golden sets that reflect current policy standards and provide reliable ground truth for assessing AI quality, accuracy, and precision.

  • Report quality issues through established workflows, taking ownership of accurate categorisation, clear documentation, and actionable feedback, and seeing insights through to meaningful impact.

  • Collaborate purposefully with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager on scoring consistency, calibration, recurring quality issues, and opportunities to strengthen AI reliability and the member experience.

  • Identify patterns and share learnings that can improve AI accuracy and precision, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency, approaching emerging challenges with Curiosity and an agile mindset.

  • Use QA platforms and AI-supported tools, including systems such as Cinder, Zendesk QA, and Bumble’s internal assessment tooling, to monitor quality and understand AI behaviour, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before acting on results.

About you

  • Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • Bring experience or transferable skills from Trust & Safety, content moderation, Customer Experience, quality assurance, or another fast-paced, policy-driven environment.

  • Have a sharp eye for detail and can objectively evaluate conversations, moderation decisions, and other interactions against established policies, processes, and quality standards.

  • Bring familiarity with conversational AI systems, chatbots, automated moderation, or AI-supported workflows, with the Curiosity to continue learning how these systems behave, where their limitations lie, and how human judgment can improve their effectiveness.

  • Understand, or are motivated to learn, quality assurance practices such as case labelling, calibration, consistent scoring, golden-set evaluation, and clear documentation of quality findings.

  • Are comfortable learning digital tools and platforms and can use data and quality insights to identify meaningful patterns while adapting your approach as systems, policies, and priorities evolve.

  • Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your deliverables, and see work through from insight to impact while welcoming feedback as an opportunity to learn and improve.

  • Apply AI thoughtfully and responsibly, assessing outputs for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness rather than relying on them without review, and demonstrate Bumble’s values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and colleagues.

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.
